On playing the player’s ball in a wrong way.

On deliberately throwing the ball outside the side line.

On wasting time.

On indecent behaviour during the game.

The free throw will be taken without the whistle and at the referee’s signal from the same place where the foul was committed. If the breach of law was committed by a defending player between the goal area and the free-throw line, the free throw will be from the line 9 metres outside the free-throw line. While making the free throw one foot of the player should be on the ground.

Penalty throw or 7-metre throw

A 7-metre throw will be given in the following cases.

When the defending team commits such a foul as wastes a clear chance of a goal.

When the goal keeper takes the ball back into his own goal area.

When some player intentionally throws the ball towards his own goal keeper and the goal keeper plays it.

If some defending player enters the goal area in such a way that he has taken advantage from it. In case of entering the goal area without taking advantage or losing balance, a free throw will be given which will be taken from the 9-metre line.

While taking the 7-metre throw all players will be outside the free-throw line. The player taking the 7-metre throw must take the throw within 3 seconds of the referee’s whistle sounding. Any player of the attacking team can take the free throw.

اگر کوئی دفاعی کھلاڑی اس طرح گول ایریا میں داخل ہو جس سے اس نے فائدہ حاصل کیا ہو۔ فائدہ حاصل کیے بغیر یا توازن کھو دینے کی صورت میں گول ایریا میں داخل ہونے کی صورت میں فری تھرو دی جائے گی جو 9 میٹر لائن سے لی جائے گی۔

7 میٹر تھرو لیتے وقت تمام کھلاڑی فری تھرو لائن کے باہر ہوں گے۔ جو کھلاڑی 7 میٹر تھرو لے رہا ہے اس کے لیے ضروری ہے کہ وہ ریفری کی وسل بجنے کے 3 سیکنڈ کے اندر تھرو لے۔ فری تھرو حملہ آور ٹیم کا کوئی بھی کھلاڑی لے سکتا ہے۔
